subject_uz: Ichki ishlar boshqarmasi qaramog'idagi voyaga yetmaganlar uchun issiq ovqat yetkazib berish bo'yicha autsorsing xizmati (4-chorak)

requirements.summary_uz: Issiq ovqat yetkazish bo'yicha SES ruxsatnomasi talab qilinadi; 2026-yilda olingan bo'lsa 20 ball.
requirements.summary_en: A sanitary (SES) permit for hot meal delivery is required; one obtained in 2026 earns 20 points.
requirements.quote: Иссиқ овқат етказиб бериш бўйича СЕСдан рухсатнома.

requirements.summary_uz: Bank ma'lumotnomasi bilan tasdiqlangan aylanma mablag'lar mavjudligi ball beradi.
requirements.summary_en: Working capital confirmed by a bank certificate is scored.
requirements.quote: Аутсорсинг хизматлари бўйича айланма маблағларининг мавжудлиги

requirements.summary_uz: Oshpaz, dietolog, haydovchi va xizmatchilar soni ball bilan baholanadi; 10 tadan ko'p bo'lsa 20 ball.
requirements.summary_en: The number of cooks, dietitians, drivers and staff is scored; more than 10 earns 20 points.
requirements.quote: 10 тадан кўп ошпаз, диетолог, шофёр ва хизматчилар учун 20 балл

requirements.summary_uz: Budjet tashkilotlari bilan avval bajarilgan shartnomalar soni ball beradi; 10 tadan ko'p bo'lsa 20 ball.
requirements.summary_en: The number of earlier fully performed contracts with budget bodies is scored; more than 10 earns 20 points.
requirements.quote: Бюджет ва бюджетдан маблағ олувчиларга шу каби хизатларни етказиб берганлиги тўғрисида аввал тузилган шартномалар

requirements.summary_uz: Issiq ovqat yetkazish uchun transport vositalari ishtirokchi nomida yoki ijara asosida bo'lishi kerak (10 ball).
requirements.summary_en: Vehicles for hot meal delivery, owned or leased, are scored (10 points).
requirements.quote: Иссиқ овқат етказиш бўйича транспортларнинг мавжудлиги

requirements.summary_uz: Taomnoma menyusi taqdim etilsa 10 ball beriladi.
requirements.quote: Махбуслар учун меъёрий таомнома менюси тақдим қилса 10 балл

requirements.summary_uz: 30 foiz avans shartnoma imzolanib, g'aznachilikda ro'yxatdan o'tgach 10 kun ichida to'lanadi.
requirements.summary_en: A 30% advance is paid within 10 days after the contract is signed and registered with the Treasury.

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi insofsiz ijrochilar yagona reestrida bo'lmasligi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder must not be on the unified register of unfair suppliers.
requirements.quote: Инсофсиз ижрочиларнинг ягона реестрида қайд этилмаганлиги.

requirements.summary_uz: Tanlov 70/30 ball usulida o'tkaziladi; o'tish bali 40.
requirements.summary_en: Scoring is 70% technical and 30% price; pass mark is 40.

flags.quote: камида 3 (уч) ойлик шартнома суммасига тенг айланма маблагларининг
flags.explanation_uz: Baholash mezonida kamida 3 oylik shartnoma summasiga teng aylanma mablag' borligini bank ma'lumotnomasi bilan tasdiqlash so'ralgan (10 ball, undan ko'p bo'lsa 20 ball, aks holda 0 ball). Shartnoma bir chorakka tuzilgani uchun bu amalda shartnomaning to'liq summasini hisobvaraqda saqlashni anglatadi. Kichik ovqatlantirish korxonalari uchun bu og'ir shart bo'lib, ball yo'qotishga olib kelishi mumkin.
flags.explanation_en: A scored criterion asks for a bank statement showing working capital equal to at least 3 months of the contract sum (10 points, 20 for more, 0 otherwise). The contract itself covers one quarter, so in effect the bidder must hold the whole contract value in cash. That is heavy for small caterers and may cost them points.
flags.rewrite_uz: «Ishtirokchi kamida bir oylik shartnoma summasiga teng aylanma mablag'ga yoki shu miqdordagi bank kafolatiga (kredit liniyasiga) ega ekanini tasdiqlaydi» deb o'zgartirilsin.
flags.rewrite_en: Change to: "The bidder confirms working capital equal to at least one month of the contract sum, or a bank guarantee (credit line) of the same amount."

flags.quote: 10 тадан кўп ошпаз, диетолог, шофёр ва хизматчилар учун 20 балл
flags.explanation_uz: Lot qiymati taxminan 23,4 mln so'm bo'lib, ovqatlanuvchilar soni cheklangan. Shunga qaramay xodimlar soni bo'yicha 10 tadan ko'p kishi uchun eng yuqori ball, 3-5 kishi uchun esa ancha past ball beriladi. Bu kichikroq, lekin ishni uddalay oladigan tashkilotlar ballini kamaytirishi mumkin.
flags.explanation_en: The lot is worth about 23.4 m UZS for a limited number of diners, yet the top score goes to bidders with more than 10 cooks, dietitians, drivers and staff, and much less to 3-5 people. This may cost points for smaller suppliers who could do the job.
flags.rewrite_uz: Ishni bajarish uchun zarur bo'lgan malakali oshpaz va dietolog mavjudligi (kamida 2 nafar) tasdiqlansa, to'liq ball beriladi.
flags.rewrite_en: Full points are given if the availability of the qualified cooks and a dietitian needed for the job (at least 2) is confirmed.

documents_needed_uz: Issiq ovqat yetkazish bo'yicha SES ruxsatnomasi
Aylanma mablag'lar mavjudligi haqida bank ma'lumotnomasi

Transport vositalari hujjatlari yoki ijara shartnomasi
Davlat ro'yxatidan o'tganlik guvohnomasi va ta'sis hujjatlari
